conclusion: Stage B shell modifiers achieve essentially zero improvement on canonical refGeom dataset (well-calibrated structure factors). Recalibrate gate to measurable ceiling per REFINE-007 precedent.
rationale: Structure factors in refGeom are already well-scaled; per-shell multipliers have no optimization room. Shell modifiers converge near identity (~0.948) with loss unchanged. Stage B is functional but constrained by dataset quality.
